problem_description:
An advanced industrial automation optimization initiative requires strategic equipment procurement to address 20 distinct functional requirements across a sophisticated manufacturing ecosystem. The procurement evaluation framework has identified 50 potential equipment options, each characterized by specific purchasing costs and distinctive operational capability matrices.
